**I. Preparation & Initial Steps (Building on "Start with the inspection records")**

1. **Start with the Inspection Records:**  Verify you have the correct vehicle information (VIN, make, model, year) and any existing service history related to the braking system.  Note any previous brake repairs, complaints, or warnings.
2. **Gather Necessary Tools:** Ensure you have all required tools for a proper brake inspection:
    *   Brake pad depth gauge
    *   Rotor/drum micrometer
